title: 营销工程师：用 AI Agent 把实验做到 100 倍

source.author: Greg Isenberg @gregisenberg
source.article: Marketing Engineers: 100x More Experiments with AI agents

headline: 营销工程师
一个人顶一个部门
scenes.tagline: 3 分钟看懂 · 建议收藏

images.prompt: a single marketer at a desk in a dark studio conducting a swarm of small glowing robot assistants, each robot carrying a different marketing asset such as blank ad cards, web page wireframes, envelopes and bar charts, flowing outward like a bright assembly line

lines: 下一个最值钱的岗位，可能叫营销工程师
一个人，带着一群AI Agent
做营销实验的速度，是传统团队的上百倍

headline: 营销进化史
实验成本一直在暴跌
scenes.quote: 谁跑的好实验最多，谁就学得最快；谁学得最快，谁就赢。

images.prompt: a long corridor of eras seen in perspective: a retro billboard and television studio, then glowing search-ad dashboards, then funnel diagrams and A/B test screens, ending in a bright room full of small AI robot helpers
two figures, an idea person holding a lightbulb and a builder holding a wrench, merging into one single glowing figure that holds both

lines: 广告狂人时代，一年只有几次出手机会
搜索广告出现后，每次点击都能算清
增长黑客时代，每个点子都要排队等工程师
现在，提想法的人自己就能做出来
营销的单位，从一次活动变成一套系统

headline: 第一步
搭好你的工作台

images.prompt: a tiny glowing workspace inside an open paper file folder on a wooden desk, a fast junior robot assistant busily reading and writing documents inside the folder
a universal glowing plug hub with cables connecting to many abstract geometric app shapes, a wall clock at seven in the morning, and a large glowing approve button waiting to be pressed

lines: 第一步，准备一个Agent工作台
Claude Code、Codex、Cursor都行
把它当成住在文件夹里的高速实习生
再用MCP把CRM、收款、文档接进来
让它每周一早上自动开工
但对外发送前，一定要等你点头

headline: 第二步
先给AI写一个大脑
scenes.quote: Agent 没问题，问题是上下文太薄。

images.prompt: a machine spitting out a pile of identical bland gray paper flyers, repetitive and generic, a disappointed figure looking at the pile
a glowing filing cabinet shaped like a brain with six softly colored drawers, a friendly new-hire robot sitting beside it reading onboarding folders

lines: 最常见的失败：一上来就开十个Agent
结果收获一堆千篇一律的废话
先建一个文件夹，像给新员工做入职培训
写清公司做什么、卖给谁、能承诺什么
品牌语气别写形容词，直接贴好坏样例
再写下创始人观点和踩过的坑

headline: 第三步
每个活动一个编号

images.prompt: streams of data from phone call sound waves, support ticket cards, deal cards and gold coins flowing into one central glowing table
a single glowing tag threaded like a bead string through an ad card, a hyperlink chain, an email envelope and a signed contract

lines: 接通通话录音、工单、成交和收入数据
一开始全部只读，写权限要慢慢挣
最关键的一件小事：每个活动一个编号
广告、链接、邮件、成交记录都带上它
才能算清：哪次营销带来了真付钱的客户

headline: 第四步
先做客户语言Agent
scenes.quote: 人们买的是那个场景，而不是功能。

images.prompt: an AI robot reading through a tall stack of call transcripts with a magnifying glass, one single sentence on a page glowing bright amber
a tired tradesperson in work clothes at a family dinner table at night, phone ringing beside the plate, warm home lighting, family in soft focus

lines: 先把一个Agent做好，再做第二个
第一个，专门读客户原话
把最近20到50通销售录音交给它
第一版大概七成准，错了就改指令
比如客户总说：受够了吃饭时接电话
这句话，就是你的广告标题

headline: 第五步
再加五个Agent

images.prompt: five distinct small robot specialists around a round table, each holding a symbolic tool: a radar dish, a magnifying glass, a paintbrush, a boomerang and a bar chart
a Monday morning desk with a short memo card and three stamp blocks shaped as a check mark, a cross and a wrench, coffee steaming beside them

lines: 稳定之后，一次只加一个
触发Agent：盯住刚开新店、刚融资的客户
搜索Agent：为买前问题做最有用的页面
创意Agent：换卖点，而不是换五十个标题
丢单Agent：客户要的功能上线就去提醒
效果Agent：每周一给出保留或砍掉的结论

headline: 第六步
护栏写进工具里
scenes.quote: 「发之前先问我」，对模型来说只是一句礼貌的建议。

images.prompt: a robot hand reaching for a big glowing red send button, blocked by a transparent glass shield with a padlock
a small vault of budget coins with a lock, next to a phone screen showing a large glowing approve button and a waiting progress ring

lines: 别指望提示词里那句“先问我”
真正的护栏，要写进工具权限
外联Agent只能存草稿，广告默认暂停
预算上限、黑名单这类硬规则交给代码
合不合适这种判断，才交给模型

headline: 第七步
跑通一个完整活动

images.prompt: an online store owner surrounded by shipping boxes, return labels and receipts, puzzled while looking at a tablet with a big glowing question mark
a simple glowing calculator interface floating above a laptop, coins and parcels balanced on a scale, a small team of robots presenting it

lines: 比如一家记账公司想接电商客户
周一，报告发现店主总在问同一句话
扣掉退货和运费，我到底赚没赚钱？
周二，各个Agent用这句原话出广告和页面
周三，你一次审完，砍掉夸大的广告
两周后，计算器页面转化最好

headline: 第八步
每周跑一遍循环
scenes.quote: 如果你整天都在修Agent的输出，问题出在上游。

images.prompt: a circular track with five glowing stations around it like a weekly loop, a calm editor at the center sorting cards into keep and discard trays
a tidy test bench with ten sample cards lined up, a robot checking each one and lighting a small green lamp above it

lines: 系统搭好后，你的工作更像编辑
周一看备忘录做取舍，周四去听销售和客服
每次否掉一个东西，写下原因放回大脑
给每个Agent留十个样例，改完就重测

headline: 这周就开始
先做第一个Agent
recap: 客户原话 · 活动编号 · 护栏进工具
先做一个 · 人来批准 · 每周迭代

images.prompt: sunrise over a small home office, one person with a laptop and a fleet of tiny glowing robot helpers lined up on the desk ready to launch

lines: 做市场的，先用20通录音做客户语言Agent
做工程的，先旁听5通销售电话
做老板的，花两小时写下你的观点
觉得有用，收藏起来，转给做营销的朋友
